name: admin_command_policy
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk command policy — reusable allow/block regular-expression lists that govern which agent-proposed commands are auto-approved or denied (deny-wins). A policy has no effect on its own; it takes effect once bound to a scope (System, Workspace, or Project) by a command policy mapping.

attributes.name: allow_list
attributes.description: Regular-expression patterns for commands that are auto-approved. A command matching any pattern here (and not matching the block list) is approved without human intervention. Each entry must be a valid regular expression; invalid patterns are rejected by the server.

attributes.name: block_list
attributes.description: Regular-expression patterns for commands that are always denied. Block takes precedence over allow (deny-wins). Each entry must be a valid regular expression; invalid patterns are rejected by the server.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata attached to the policy.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Whether the policy is active. Defaults to true.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created the policy.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last updated the policy.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the policy was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the policy was last updated (RFC 3339).
